Plan / Actual = packages with the milestone planned / achieved on or before cut-off. Progress = Actual ÷ Plan. Status shows how far actual is behind or ahead of plan.

1 Weekly milestone status

Click a milestone row to see the packages behind each number. This week = dates after previous cut-off up to cut-off. Cumulative = dates on or before cut-off. Next week = dates after cut-off up to cut-off + 7 days. Counts are packages, where each facility (and batch) of a package code is its own package with its own timeline.

PSR Package register

Each dot is a key milestone: filled teal = actual achieved, red = plan date passed without actual, amber ring = forecast later than plan, grey = upcoming on plan, · = not applicable. Date under the dot = forecast (or plan). Click a package for full detail and its POs.

PSR Detail sheet

Same rows and columns as sheet PSR in Excel (column B to the Remark column). Row number = Excel row. Click any row to open that package's detail. Second header line = progress weight for Tagged / Bulk at that milestone.

1 By discipline package × facility · weighted progress on the 11 expediting milestones

2 Delivery profile packages shipped from port per month · next 12 months

2.2 Expediting milestones sheet Milestones · LOA → spares, plan / forecast / actual

Dots use the Expediting Report (forecast / actual entered by the expeditor); without the file they show the PSR baseline. Teal = actual, red = plan passed without actual, amber ring = forecast later than plan, grey = upcoming.
